Home / Display Views
Display Views

Visualize your work freely with 7 display views.

See the same tasks through 7 different lenses — List, Calendar, Matrix, Gantt, Kanban, Summary, Burndown. Switch tabs to change your perspective anytime.

📋

List

Grouped by due date. Your everyday main view
📅

Calendar

See due dates by the month. A 7-week rolling view is also available
⊞

Matrix

A 4-quadrant bubble chart of urgency x importance
🌳

Gantt

Parent-Child Task Tree + Dependencies & Critical Path
🗂

Kanban

Move cards between statuses with drag and drop
📝

Summary

Copyable as text. Daily and weekly report drafts are generated automatically too
📉

Burndown / Workload

Progress management with planned/actual lines, plus visualized hours per assignee

Start by trying it out with your own tasks

Switch views with a single click.

Backlog My Tasks

A Chrome extension that lets you check and manage all your assigned Backlog tasks across multiple spaces in one place. With 7 display views and a Project Dashboard, everyday task management and tracking team progress become effortless.
